text:
kevin_support: FYI AcmeFin reporting failed payment webhooks since ~09:10 UTC. They see 403s from their firewall and say our egress IPs changed overnight. Can someone quick-check?

maria_csm: Customer provided sample: previously we were coming from 52.9.12.34, now requests show 35.7.14.90. They only allowlisted 52.9.12.32/29 on their firewall.

alex_netops: Looking at SNAT allocator... pulling audit for their VPC id vpc-0a1b2c3. One-minute.

alex_netops: Confirmed — automated SNAT rebalance ran at 2026-03-16T23:45:12Z for that region. Their subnet was moved to a different SNAT block: new block 35.7.14.88/30 (IPs .88-.91), old block 52.9.12.32/29 removed.

dinesh_eng: Can reproduce quickly by firing a webhook from their VPC in our test env — saw source 35.7.14.90 in our egress logs.

kevin_support: Customer says their firewall only had the single /29, so that's why only some webhooks hit and ~50% failing. They want a workaround while they update allowlist.

alex_netops: Short term: ask customer to allowlist the new /30 (35.7.14.88/30) or the broader /24 if they prefer. Long term: offer static/reserved egress for production webhooks (Private/Dedicated) so IPs don't rotate.

maria_csm: I told them to update to allowlist 35.7.14.88/30 for now and that we'll keep an eye. Also warned about possible future rebalances unless they pick reserved egress.

dinesh_eng: Repro steps I ran for ops notes:
```
# from test instance in same vpc
dig +short myip.opendns.com @resolver1.opendns.com  # returns 35.7.14.90
curl -v https://webhook.acmefin.example/endpoint  # observed 403 from customer firewall
```

alex_netops: Adding more detail: rebalance triggered because SNAT utilization in that AZ exceeded threshold 0.78 and autoscaler redistributed /28 blocks across tenants. This tenant had a single /29 previously and got moved to a different host's SNAT pool during cleanup.

kevin_support: Can we mark this customer as "do not rebalance" while they update allowlist? Any risk?

alex_netops: We can add a short-lived reservation (48h) on the SNAT allocator for them to prevent immediate reassign. Doing that now. Will escalate to infra for longer reserve if they convert to reserved egress.

sre-bot: Incident INC-20260316-4521 created and assigned to netops.

dinesh_eng: Ops note for postmortem: recommend we surface SNAT CIDR changes in console notifications for Private customers and offer a CSV of current assigned egress CIDRs. Also suggest adding a reminder in onboarding docs to allowlist full allocated block (/28) rather than a single IP.

maria_csm: Customer accepted temp ask to add /30. They requested ETA for permanent reserved egress; I opened sales ticket.

kevin_support: Thanks — leaving thread open until reservation confirmed. Will update with customer confirmation when they finish allowlist change. :thumbsup:
